static_traits.name: Luo Ailin
static_traits.social_status: Having a few friends to talk to, but relationships are strained due to avoiding water activities
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no psychotherapy received in the past; no history of similar problems
static_traits.language_features: Expresses clearly, highly cooperative, able to self-reflect; tone slightly anxious but maintains positivity and hope

basic_info.main_problem: I feel I will never be good at paddleboarding, because water conditions have been poor lately, which makes me feel incompetent and frustrated.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these feelings of incompetence and frustration have begun to affect my overall mood and my enjoyment of activities; I do not want to give up the paddleboarding I love because of these recent experiences.

special_situations.event: Practices paddleboarding in harsh water conditions (strong waves, rough sea) and falls into the water multiple times
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot keep my balance under difficult conditions and fail repeatedly, it means I am not suited to paddleboarding
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: On the one hand, forces continuing to practice in bad water conditions to prove themselves; on the other hand, gradually avoids getting in the water to avoid failing again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never learn this; I am not suited for it

special_situations.event: Seeing others do stand-up paddleboarding easily and smoothly
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others do it easily and I cannot, it means I am inferior to others and lack ability
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding water activities with friends, reducing contact with water-related socializing
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not as good as them, I cannot do it

special_situations.event: Water conditions continuously poor for a period of time
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the water conditions are always bad, I will never be able to improve
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Mainly attributing inability to progress to external water conditions, reducing practice frequency
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Water conditions will always affect me in the future; I am doomed not to get better

special_situations.event: When preparing to get in the water or planning paddleboard practice
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only performing well under all conditions counts as capable; otherwise one is a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Measured by the standard of 'either perfect or not at all', chooses to completely avoid going on the water
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If I cannot do well this time, then I am a failure

core_conflict.wish: Longing to feel competent, in control and enjoy paddleboarding
core_conflict.fear: Fearing failure, losing face, and being proven 'incompetent'
defense_goal: Reduces shame and anxiety and maintains self-esteem by avoiding going on the water and attributing failure to external water conditions

object_relations.self_representation: A clumsy learner who fails easily
object_relations.object_representation: Relaxed and at ease skilled persons/bystanders who may make one feel ashamed by comparison

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking in counseling about reasons for inability to progress or reviewing failure experiences
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tends to regard failure entirely as caused by external water conditions, weakening self-adjustable factors, in order to reduce feelings of being judged and shame
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Emphasizes external causes (water conditions) and temporary factors, using a plain and affirmative tone; remains cautious about inquiries into personal ability and expands little, highlighting the narrative that 'conditions were bad' to reduce discomfort.

manifestations: Lives alone; avoids water activities with friends; has not expressed feelings of incompetence and frustration to friends

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Worries about failure and does not engage much with water-related social settings
Not revealing one's sense of incompetence to friends
Self-blaming in the narrative and overly cautiously evaluating whether to continue practicing

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: Avoiding the discomfort of failure by avoiding on-water practice
Socially avoiding invitations or topics involving water activities

exception_events.target_problem: When water conditions are bad or when preparing to get in the water to practice, the client usually develops feelings of incompetence and frustration and avoids getting in the water, leading to interrupted practice and stagnant skills.
exception_events.unique_outcome: On relatively calm days, the client can stand longer and paddle more, performing better than before with a more stable experience.
exception_events.reason: Clues: because the water conditions were calmer (different situation), and the client chose to practice under better conditions (different approach), this time the client was not trapped by expectations of failure and showed more stable performance.

positive_force: Maintaining interest in and motivation for paddleboarding
Able to notice and describe changes in own thinking patterns (acknowledges performing better in calm water conditions)
Willing to try more realistic thought restructuring and setting small goals
Having some social support (friends to talk with)
Positive attitude, willing to change gradually
negative_force: Negative tendency of fortune telling ('I will never improve')
Comparing others with oneself and belittling oneself (comparing and despairing)
Increased avoidance behavior, reduced practice opportunities
Mainly attributes failure externally to maintain self-esteem, limiting the pathways for improving self-efficacy

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids on-water practice and feels marked anxiety and frustration toward paddleboarding
antecedent: Seeing or planning to do stand-up paddleboarding
Turbulent water conditions or anticipating a poor performance
Seeing others do stand-up paddleboarding with ease
target_behavior.core_reason: Worry about failure and shame, and automatic thinking of catastrophizing, all-or-nothing thinking, and overgeneralization maintain the sense of incompetence
target_behavior.function: Escapes failure and embarrassment, reducing anxiety and shame in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Overall mood declines, enjoyment of activities decreases, interpersonal relationships are strained, and skill improvement is blocked
